content.answer_markdown: The LLM Exchanges screen shows the records of language model calls related to the platform. Each record includes the system text, prompt, and reply of a specific model call. This allows users to review the interactions with the language model that explain engine figures or cite report passages. However, currently no LLM Exchange is selected on the screen, so no specific exchange details are displayed.
